comment_regular: Oblivion scalar key-track evaluator. Returns the sole/first value for one key or sentinel time; otherwise resumes from the caller cursor, rewinds to key 0 when sample time precedes it, finds the bracketing timestamps using the supplied key stride, computes normalized segment time, dispatches by interpolation type, and stores the lower-key cursor.
